verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path —

verses.arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
verses.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked Your anger or of those who are astray.
verses.transliteration: Siratal lazeena an'amta 'alayhim ghayril maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad daaleen

verses.translation: About what are they asking one another?
About the great news
That over which they are in disagreement
No! They are going to know
Then no! They are going to know
Have We not made the earth a resting place?
And the mountains as pegs?
And created you in pairs
And made your sleep as rest
And made the night as covering
And made the day for livelihood
And built above you seven strong heavens
And made a blazing lamp
And sent down from rain clouds pouring water
That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of entwined growth
Indeed the Day of Judgement is an appointed time

verses.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجًا
verses.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
And the mountains are removed and will be a mirage
Indeed Hellfire is a place of ambush
For the transgressors a place of return
In which they will remain for ages

verses.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.transliteration: Lā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan wa-lā sharābā
verses.translation: They will not taste in it any coolness or drink
Except scalding water and purulent discharge
An appropriate recompense
Indeed they were not expecting an account
And they denied Our verses with strong denial
But all things We have enumerated in writing
So taste, for We will add to you nothing but punishment
Indeed for the righteous is attainment
Gardens and grapevines
And full-breasted companions of equal age
And a full cup

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
verses.transliteration: Lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan wa-lā kidhdhābā
verses.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein, nor any falsehood
As a reward from your Lord — a sufficient gift

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابًا
verses.transliteration: Rabbis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-mā baynahumar-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna minhu khiṭābā
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Most Merciful — they possess no power of speech from Him

verses.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yaqūmur-rūḥu wal-malāʾikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahur-raḥmānu wa-qāla ṣawābā
verses.translation: The Day the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.transliteration: Dhālikal-yawmul-ḥaqqu fa-man shāʾattakhadha ilā rabbihī maʾābā
verses.translation: That is the Day of Truth; so whoever wills may take a return to his Lord

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبًا
verses.transliteration: Innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓurul-marʾu mā qaddamat yadāhu wa-yaqūlul-kāfiru yā laytanī kuntu turābā
verses.translation: Indeed We have warned you of a near punishment — the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth, and the disbeliever will say: 'Oh, I wish I were dust!'
When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
And when the stars fall, dispersing
And when the mountains are moved
And when full-term she-camels are neglected
And when the wild beasts are gathered
And when the seas are filled with flame
And when the souls are paired
And when the girl buried alive is asked
For what sin she was killed
And when the pages are spread open
And when the sky is stripped away
And when Hellfire is set ablaze
And when Paradise is brought near
A soul will know what it has brought
So I swear by the retreating stars
Those that run and hide
And by the night as it departs
And by the dawn as it breathes
Indeed it is the word of a noble Messenger

verses.arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٍ
verses.translation: Owner of power, with the Owner of the Throne, secure
Obeyed there and trustworthy
And your companion is not insane
And he has already seen him on the clear horizon
And he is not withholding of the unseen
And it is not the word of a cursed devil
So where are you going?
It is not except a reminder to the worlds
For whoever among you wills to take a straight course

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-mā tashāʾūna illā an yashāʾa Allāhu rabbul-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allah wills — Lord of the worlds
When the sky breaks apart
And when the stars fall, scattering
And when the seas are erupted
And when the graves are overturned
A soul will know what it has put forth and left behind

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Yā ayyuhal-insānu mā gharraka bi-rabbik al-karīm
verses.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous
Who created you, proportioned you, and assembled you

verses.arabic: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.transliteration: Fī ayyi ṣūratin mā shāʾa rakkabak
verses.translation: In whatever form He willed, He assembled you
No! But you deny the Judgement
And indeed, over you are keepers
Noble and recording
They know whatever you do
Indeed the righteous will be in pleasure
And indeed the wicked will be in Hellfire
They will burn in it on the Day of Judgement
And they will not be absent from it
And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: Again, what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

verses.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٍ شَيۡـًٔا وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma lā tamliku nafsun li-nafsin shayan wal-amru yawmaʾidhin lillāh
verses.translation: The Day when no soul will avail another soul at all, and the command that Day is with Allah
Woe to those who give less than due

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
verses.translation: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full
But if they give by measure or weight to them, they cause loss
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
verses.translation: No! Indeed the record of the wicked is in Sijjeen
And what can make you know what is Sijjeen?
It is a register inscribed
Woe, that Day, to the deniers
Those who deny the Day of Recompense

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-mā yukadhdhibu bihi illā kullu muʿtadin athīm
verses.translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Idhā tutlā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīrul-awwalīn
verses.translation: Who, when Our verses are recited to him, says 'legends of the former peoples'

verses.arabic: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūn
verses.translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
verses.translation: No! Indeed they from their Lord that Day will be partitioned
Then indeed they will burn in Hellfire

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma yuqālu hādhal-ladhī kuntum bihi tukadhdhibūn
verses.translation: Then it will be said: 'This is what you used to deny'

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.translation: No! Indeed the record of the righteous is in Illiyyeen
And what can make you know what is Illiyyeen?
It is a register inscribed
Those brought near witness it
Indeed, the righteous will be in bliss
On adorned couches, observing
You will recognize on their faces the radiance of pleasure
They will be given to drink of pure wine, sealed

words.translation: they will be given to drink

verses.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٌ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.translation: Its seal is musk, so for that let the competitors compete
And its mixture is from Tasneem
A spring from which those brought near drink

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innal-ladhīna ajramū kānū minal-ladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūn
verses.translation: Indeed those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed
And when they passed by them, they winked at one another

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
verses.translation: And when they returned to their people, they returned jesting

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā raʾawhumq qālū inna hāʾulāʾi laḍāllūn
verses.translation: And when they saw them, they said, 'Indeed those are truly lost'
And they were not sent as keepers over them

verses.arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.translation: So today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers
On adorned couches, observing

verses.arabic: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
verses.translation: Have the disbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?
When the sky has split open
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated to
And when the earth has been extended
And has cast out what was within it and relinquished
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated to

verses.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحًا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Yā ayyuhal-insānu innaka kādiḥun ilā rabbika kadḥan fa-mulāqīh
verses.translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with great exertion and will meet Him
So as for one who is given his record in his right hand
He will be judged with an easy account
And will return to his people in happiness

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
verses.transliteration: Wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu warāʾa ẓahrih
verses.translation: But as for one who is given his record behind his back
He will cry out for destruction
And will burn in a blazing fire
Indeed he had been among his people in happiness
Indeed he thought he would never return

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Balā inna rabbahu kāna bihi baṣīrā
verses.translation: Yes! Indeed his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing
So I swear by the twilight glow
And the night and what it envelops
And the moon when it becomes full
You will surely experience state after state
So what is the matter with them that they do not believe?

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَ
verses.translation: And when the Quran is recited to them, they do not prostrate
But those who disbelieve deny
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
So give them tidings of a painful punishment

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Illal-ladhīna āmanū wa-ʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūn
verses.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds — for them is a reward uninterrupted
By the sky containing great stars
And by the promised Day
And the witness and what is witnessed
Cursed were the companions of the trench
The fire full of fuel
When they were sitting over it

verses.arabic: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
verses.transliteration: Wa-hum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bil-muʾminīna shuhūd
verses.translation: And they were witnesses to what they were doing to the believers

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-mā naqamū minhum illā an yuʾminū billāhil-ʿazīzil-ḥamīd
verses.translation: And they resented them for no reason except that they believed in Allah, the Exalted, the Praiseworthy

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī lahu mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wallāhu ʿalā kulli shayʾin shahīd
verses.translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is witness over all things

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
verses.transliteration: Innal-ladhīna fatanul-muʾminīna wal-muʾmināti thumma lam yatūbū falahum ʿadhābu jahannama wa-lahum ʿadhābul-ḥarīq
verses.translation: Indeed, those who tormented the believing men and believing women and then did not repent will have the punishment of Hell and will have the punishment of burning

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Innal-ladhīna āmanū wa-ʿamilus-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru dhālikal-fawzul-kabīr
verses.translation: Indeed, those who believed and did righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow — that is the great attainment
Indeed, the assault of your Lord is severe
Indeed, it is He who originates and repeats
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
Owner of the Glorious Throne
Effecter of what He intends
Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
Of Pharaoh and Thamud?
But those who disbelieve are in denial
But Allah encompasses them from behind
But this is an honored Quran
In a Preserved Tablet
By the sky and the night comer —
And what can make you know what is the night comer?
It is the piercing star!

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
verses.translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
verses.transliteration: In kullu nafsin lamma alayhaa hafiz

verses.translation: So let man observe from what he was created.
He was created from a fluid, ejected,
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
verses.translation: Then he will have no power and no helper.
verses.transliteration: Fama lahu min quwwatiw wa la naasir

verses.translation: By the sky which returns [rain]
And [by] the earth which cracks open,
Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
And it is not amusement.
Indeed, they are planning a plan,
And I am planning a plan.
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
Who created and proportioned
And who destined and [then] guided
And who brings out the pasture
And [then] makes it black stubble.
We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verses.translation: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
verses.transliteration: Illa ma shaa-allaahu innahu ya'lamul jahra wa ma yakhfa

verses.translation: And We will ease you toward ease.
So remind, if the reminder should benefit,
The one who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
But the most wretched one will avoid it —
Who will [then] enter the greatest Fire,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.translation: Neither dying therein nor living.
verses.transliteration: Thumma la yamootu feeha wa la yahya

verses.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
But you prefer the worldly life,
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
Some faces, that Day, will be humbled,
Laboring [hard] and exhausted,
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
verses.translation: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
verses.transliteration: Laysa lahum ta'aamun illa min daree'

words.meaning: there will not be for them

verses.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍ
verses.translation: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
verses.transliteration: La yusminu wa la yughnee min joo'

verses.translation: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
With their effort [they are] satisfied.
In an elevated garden,
Therein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
Within it is a flowing spring.
Within it are couches raised high
And cups put in place
And cushions lined up
And carpets spread around.

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verses.translation: Then do they not look at the camels — how they are created?
verses.transliteration: Afala yanzuroona ilal ibili kayfa khuliqat

verses.translation: And at the sky — how it is raised?
And at the mountains — how they are erected?
And at the earth — how it is spread out?
So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
You are not over them a controller.
However, he who turns away and disbelieves —
Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Indeed, to Us is their return.
Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
By the dawn
And [by] ten nights
And [by] the even [number] and the odd
And [by] the night when it passes,

verses.arabic: هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ
verses.translation: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
verses.transliteration: Hal fee zalika qasamul lizi hijr

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.translation: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with 'Aad —
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa fa'ala rabbuka bi aad

verses.translation: [With] Iram — who had lofty pillars,

verses.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ
verses.translation: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
verses.transliteration: Allati lam yukhlaq mithluhaa fil bilaad

verses.translation: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
verses.transliteration: Wa thamooda allazeena jaaboo as-sakhra bil waad

verses.translation: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? —
Who all transgressed within the lands
And increased therein the corruption.
So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْإِنسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ
verses.translation: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, 'My Lord has honored me.'
verses.transliteration: Fa ammal insaanu iza mab talaahu rabbuh fa akramahu wa na'amahu fa yaqoolu rabbi akraman

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ
verses.translation: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, 'My Lord has humiliated me.'
verses.transliteration: Wa amma iza mab talaahu fa qadara alayhi rizqahu fa yaqoolu rabbi ahaanan

verses.translation: No! But you do not honor the orphan
And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
verses.transliteration: Wa la tahaaaddoona ala ta'aamil miskeen

verses.translation: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
And you love wealth with immense love.

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
verses.translation: No! When the earth has been leveled — pounded and crushed —
verses.transliteration: Kalla iza dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka

verses.translation: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
verses.transliteration: Wa jaa-a rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffa

verses.arabic: وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.translation: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell — that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
verses.transliteration: Wa jee-a yawma-izim bi jahannama yawma-iziy yatazakkarul insaanu wa anna lahuz zikra

words.meaning: but what good is the remembrance

verses.translation: He will say, 'Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life.'
So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
verses.transliteration: Fa yawma-izil la yu'azzibu azaabahu ahad

verses.translation: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
[To the righteous it will be said], 'O reassured soul,
Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
And enter among My [righteous] servants
And enter My Paradise.'
I swear by this city
And you are free of restriction in this city
And the father and what he fathered
We have certainly created man into hardship

verses.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٌ
verses.transliteration: Ayaḥsabu an lan yaqdira ʿalayhi aḥad
verses.translation: Does he think that no one has power over him?
He says, 'I have spent wealth in abundance'
Does he think that no one has seen him?
Did We not make for him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And have shown him the two ways?
Yet he has not broken through the difficult pass
And what can make you know what the difficult pass is?
It is the freeing of a slave

verses.arabic: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٌ فِي يَوۡمٍ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٍ
verses.transliteration: Aw iṭʿāmun fī yawmin dhī masghabah
verses.translation: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
An orphan of close relation
Or a poor person in misery

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
verses.transliteration: Thumma kāna minal-ladhīna āmanū wa-tawāṣaw biṣ-ṣabri wa-tawāṣaw bil-marḥamah
verses.translation: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion
Those are the companions of the right

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
verses.translation: But those who disbelieved in Our signs — those are the companions of the left
Over them will be fire closed in
By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
He has succeeded who purifies it,
And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
verses.translation: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, '[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink.'
verses.transliteration: Fa qaala lahum rasoolullaahi naaqatal laahi wa suqyaha

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا
verses.translation: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
verses.transliteration: Fa kazzaboohu fa aqaroohaa fadamdama alayhim rabbuhum bizambihim fasawwaha

verses.translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
By the night when it covers
And [by] the day when it appears
And [by] He who created the male and female,
verses.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal untha

verses.translation: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
As for he who gives and fears Allah
And believes in the best [reward],
We will ease him toward ease.
But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
And denies the best [reward],
We will ease him toward difficulty.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ
verses.translation: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
verses.transliteration: Wa maa yughnee anhu maaluhu iza taradda

verses.translation: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one —
Who had denied and turned away.
But the righteous one will avoid it —
Who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

verses.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ
verses.translation: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.transliteration: Wa maa li-ahadin indahu min ni'matin tujza

verses.translation: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
And he is going to be satisfied.
By the morning brightness
And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
verses.transliteration: Maa wadda'aka rabbuka wa maa qalaa

verses.translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
And We removed from you your burden
Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
By the fig and the olive
And the Mount of Sinai
And this secure city (Makkah)

verses.arabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٍ
verses.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature
Then We return him to the lowest of the low

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Illal-ladhīna āmanū wa-ʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fa-lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūn
verses.translation: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds — for they will have a reward uninterrupted
So what yet causes you to deny the Judgement?
Is Allah not the most just of judges?
Read in the name of your Lord who created
Created man from a clinging substance
Read, and your Lord is the most Generous
Who taught by the pen
Taught man that which he knew not
No! Indeed, man transgresses
Because he sees himself self-sufficient
Indeed, to your Lord is the return
Have you seen the one who forbids
A servant when he prays?
Have you seen if he is upon guidance
Or enjoins righteousness?
Have you seen if he denies and turns away?
Does he not know that Allah sees?

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: Kallā la-in lam yantahi la-nasfaʿan bin-nāṣiyah
verses.translation: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
A lying, sinning forelock
Then let him call his associates
We will call the angels of Hell
No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near
Indeed, We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
verses.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa laylatul qadr

verses.arabic: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.transliteration: Laylatul qadri khayrum min alfi shahr

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
verses.transliteration: Tanazzalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feehaa bi-izni rabbihim min kulli amr

verses.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
verses.transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.translation: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not going to desist until there came to them clear evidence —
verses.transliteration: Lam yakunil lazeena kafaroo min ahlil kitaabi wal mushrikeena munfakkeena hatta ta-tiyahumul bayyinah

verses.arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
verses.translation: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
Within which are correct writings.

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.translation: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
verses.transliteration: Wa ma tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaba illa mim ba'di ma jaa-at humul bayyinah

verses.arabic: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ
verses.translation: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
verses.transliteration: Wa maa umiroo illa liya'budul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena hunafaa-a wa yuqeemus salaata wa yu-tuz zakaata wa zalika deenul qayyimah

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.translation: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
verses.transliteration: Innal lazeena kafaroo min ahlil kitaabi wal mushrikeena fee naari jahannama khalideena feeha ulaa-ika hum sharrul bareeyah

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds — those are the best of creatures.
verses.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa amiluS saalihaati ulaa-ika hum khayrul bareeyah

verses.arabic: جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ
verses.translation: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
verses.transliteration: Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jannaatu adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khalideena feeha abadan radiyal laahu anhum wa radoo anh, zaalika liman khashiya rabbah

verses.translation: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens
And man says, 'What is [wrong] with it?' —
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ
verses.translation: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
verses.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
verses.transliteration: Faman ya'mal mithqala zarratin khayray yarah

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
verses.translation: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verses.transliteration: Wa may ya'mal mithqala zarratin sharrayy yarah

verses.translation: By the racers, panting,
And the producers of sparks [when] striking
And the chargers at dawn,
Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.
verses.transliteration: Wa innahu ala zaalika la shaheed

verses.translation: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
verses.transliteration: Wa innahu lihubbil khayri la shadeed

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ
verses.translation: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered,
verses.transliteration: Afala ya'lamu iza bu'thira ma fil quboor

verses.translation: And that within the breasts is obtained [i.e., exposed],
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.
verses.transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yawma-izil la khabeer

verses.translation: The Calamity —
What is the Calamity?
And what can make you know what is the Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like scattered moths
verses.transliteration: Yawma yakoonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

verses.translation: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
verses.transliteration: Wa takoonul jibaalu kal ihnil manfoosh

verses.translation: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
Until you visit the graveyards.
No! You are going to know.
Then, no! You are going to know.
No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
By time,
Indeed, mankind is in loss,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
verses.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanu wa amiluS saalihaati wa tawasaw bil haqqi wa tawasaw bis sabr

verses.translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.
Indeed, it will be closed down upon them
In extended columns.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
verses.translation: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
verses.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa fa'ala rabbuka bi-as-haabil feel

verses.translation: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.
For the accustomed security of the Quraysh —
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer —
Let them worship the Lord of this House,

verses.arabic: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ
verses.translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
verses.transliteration: Allazi at'amahum min joo'in wa aamanahum min khawf

verses.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer —
Those who make show [of their deeds]
And withhold [simple] assistance.
Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
Say, O disbelievers,
I do not worship what you worship.
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.

words.meaning: and for me is my religion

verses.translation: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,

verses.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.translation: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
verses.transliteration: Wa ra-aytan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwaaja

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
verses.translation: Then exalt Him with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
verses.transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirh innahu kaana tawwaaba

verses.translation: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
verses.transliteration: Tabbat yadaa abi lahabiw wa tabb

verses.arabic: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.translation: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
verses.transliteration: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa maa kasab

verses.translation: He will [soon] enter a Fire of blazing flame
And his wife [as well] — the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
Say, He is Allah, [who is] One,
Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
He neither begets nor is born,
Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
verses.transliteration: Wa lam yakul lahoo kufuwan ahad

verses.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghaasiqin iza waqab

verses.translation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharrin naffaasaati fil uqad

verses.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri haasidin iza hasad

verses.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
The Sovereign of mankind.
The God of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind —
From among the jinn and mankind.
